description:
[read-only] Whether the brand sends lead follow-ups from its own mailbox: the address, provider, status, daily send cap (limit, remaining, reset), the fallback when it cannot send (resend = flayr's sender, hold = do not send) and open/link tracking. Use an `id` from list_brands.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/brands/{id}/mailbox.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_mailbox_get
title: Get a brand's connected mailbox
